nonBlocking.issue: At P8.2 the harness.stylesheetRefs marker does nothing. P6.5 was skipped (STATE: 'Preempted: the owner acted on DNS'), so the baseline that VERIFICATION.md 8a.3 names does not exist. The only baseline is the P6.2 attempt-3 manifests, whose harness is {embeddedPosts:1} with no stylesheetRefs marker. Any compare against them falls back to the counted-skip branch, so the manual stylesheetRefsBothAbsent == 0 check in 8a.3 is still the operative guard. Mitigating fact: the P6.2 A and B manifests carry stylesheetRefs on 216/216 2xx HTML entries, so if B lacks the field on any page the compare fails with a stylesheetRefsMissing diff (checked with case mixedStripB). Orchestrator: decide which baseline P8.2 uses and keep requiring stylesheetRefsBothAbsent 0 in P8.2-suite-summary.json.

The marker is honoured only when BOTH manifests carry it, unlike checkEmbeddedPostsCoverage, which checks each manifest on its own marker. With B marked and A unmarked, a 2xx HTML page missing stylesheetRefs on both sides still passes (case bMarkedOnlyBothStrip: passed true, stylesheetRefsBothAbsent 1). stylesheetRefsBothAbsent is reported and printed as a NOTE but never changes the exit code. This matches the C-A3b-5 wording and the implementer's description. It is a hardening option, not a defect: check each marked manifest for its own 2xx HTML entries that have neither stylesheetRefs nor htmlError, or return a non-zero exit when stylesheetRefsBothAbsent > 0.

There is a sibling gap outside the literal C-A3b-5 scope, and it predates this change. xmlError and jsonError get the same treatment htmlError used to get: when both sides fail to parse, sitemapEntries and json are absent on both sides and compareEntry emits no diff. For /sitemap.xml a search engine would notice. Recommend a follow-up with the same pattern: diff when either side has the error, and add both fields to FORBIDDEN_ALLOWLIST_FIELDS.

This predates the change and is outside scope. A fetch diff (a.error or b.error) can still be allowlisted with pinned values, because 'fetch' is not in FORBIDDEN_ALLOWLIST_FIELDS. It returns before the new htmlError check, which is correct, but a fetch failure on one side is a harness or availability signal of the same kind. Consider forbidding it.

I confirmed the implementer's major issue independently. My own live selftest.mjs run shows tie-permutation-real-data failing with 'embedded-posts-parse-error-a'. None of lib/, selftest.mjs or tie-permutation.mjs is in this diff, so the failure predates the change. Note that extractHtml (lib/extract.mjs:81) also parses normalizeHtmlNoise output, so the dpl strip changes the text that extractHtml parses, not only the tie-permutation input. The P6.2 regression is unchanged, so parity output is not affected today. This needs to be tracked to a step before any tie-permutation proof is relied on at P8.2. Not blocking for C-A3b-5.

reviewerSummary:
Approved, 0 blocking findings. C-A3b-5 is met by the working-tree diff under scripts/migration/parity. stylesheetRefsMissing (one side null, or both sides null when both manifests carry harness.stylesheetRefs === 1) and htmlError (either side, checked before the both-404 return) are both in FORBIDDEN_ALLOWLIST_FIELDS. capture.mjs:370 writes the marker in full and compact mode. The only allowlist matcher is matchAllowlist, which compares field names exactly, and every allowlist passes through validateAllowlist first, both in compareManifests and on the command line. No downstream code reads diff categories, so the new 'harness' category cannot be filtered out. I found no path where these diffs are allowlisted or skipped silently. The one exception is the mixed-marker case below, where the skip is counted rather than silent.

Adversarial probes I ran myself, in memory on the real P6.2 attempt-3 manifests:
- Both markers injected, no other change: identical result (failedUnallowed 0, allowlisted 4, 1165 diffs).
- Both markers set, stylesheetRefs stripped from both sides of '/': fails with /:stylesheetRefsMissing.
- A unmarked, B marked, stripped from B only: fails.
- Only B marked, stripped from both sides: passes with stylesheetRefsBothAbsent 1, which is counted, not silent.
- Marker set to true or "1": treated as unmarked, which fails safe.
- Allowlist entries for stylesheetRefsMissing, or for htmlError with the pattern ^.*$: rejected.
- An allowlist entry on the old field stylesheetRefs pinned to {a:[...], b:null} or {a:null, b:null}: passes validation but no longer matches anything, so the compare fails with stylesheetRefsMissing.
- htmlError on both sides for a 404, a 500 and a 200 page: each fails on htmlError/harness.

Self-tests I reran, with output in the scratchpad:
- selftest-c-a3b-5: 12/12 PASS
- selftest-link-header: 21/21 PASS
- selftest-p5.3: 12/12 PASS
- live selftest.mjs against https://www.growmax.io: 19/21 PASS, 1 FAIL, 1 DEFERRED. The failure is tie-permutation-real-data with embedded-posts-parse-error-a, from the lib/extract.mjs:20 dpl regex, which is not in this diff.

P6.2 regression, which I reran: exit 0, 297 URLs, failedUnallowed 0, allowlisted 4 (/ visibleTextHash, / internalLinks, /sitemap.xml sitemapEntries, <hashed-css-assets> hashedCssSha256), stylesheetRefsBothAbsent 0, 1165 diffs. The P6.2 A and B manifests have stylesheetRefs on 216/216 2xx HTML entries and 0 htmlError entries. state.mjs scan was clean (9 files).

Most important non-blocking point: P6.5 was skipped because the owner preempted it, so no baseline carries the marker. At P8.2 the marker is inert against the P6.2 manifests, and the manual stylesheetRefsBothAbsent == 0 check in VERIFICATION 8a.3 stays the operative guard. The orchestrator must also decide which baseline P8.2 compares against. The other non-blocking points are a follow-up for the same gap on xmlError and jsonError, and a per-side marker check.
